environment.description: Quarkus serverless function deployed on AWS Lambda via quarkus-amazon-lambda-http adapter behind API Gateway (HTTP API type, no WAF). Istio sidecar is NOT present (Lambda doesn't run in service mesh). Auth tokens are long-lived (24h) OIDC tokens issued by corporate IdP. Comments are rendered server-side and served to all users viewing the article. No Content-Security-Policy headers configured on API Gateway responses.

config.auth: OIDC tokens with 24h expiry, validated in-code only
